provenance.kind: synthetic test fixture - NOT vulnerability intelligence

purpose: A host whose name contains 'nonce-' is not a nonce source, so it does not neutralise 'unsafe-inline' and the policy must be reported.

groundTruth.rationale: Only a quoted nonce-source or hash-source neutralises 'unsafe-inline' (CSP3). 'https://nonce-cdn.example' is an ordinary host source; the policy lets inline script run, so the finding stands.

limitations: Observation mode: a synthetic response object, not a live page.
The rule does not judge whether a nonce is used elsewhere in the policy.
